The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-20: zoo owner, "this must be studied, including the list of kill on sight"; "yes go, define them" (pilots and small runs only, all classes; the Rangers are set aside).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-20, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#529; borg-reborn-rs #759, #760; #511's
pilot on 78b8f297 before they were shipped). Pilot (RULES 16); a small tier of what leads follows the gate and
the owner. Eight arms, 18 starts each (144 games). All classes.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's switch values in params-core.json and its list in the cell's user
copy (the borg_scary_list_lines applied); ctl plays as main c4163095's shipped settings; every cell ends in death,
turn_cap or borg_stopped (stalls, timeouts and crashes kept apart); frozen-turn bursts classified.
Report per arm and per class: deaths and causes, CL at death, final and maximum level, deepest level; paired
rescued and newly killed against ctl (exact McNemar), identical plays; per game the attack-on-sight reasons logged
(fast-fragile, breeder) and the winning-fight attacks and refusals; for every death the monster, its distance and
whether it was on the list. A switch or list entry that never fires (identical plays) is "not tested".
Descriptive (RULES 14).
